title: rudbeckia fulgida var. spathulata
intro: Rudbeckia fulgida var. spathulata, commonly known as Yellow Coneflower, is a perennial plant native to North America, characterized by its bright yellow flowers and narrow leaves. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to alleviate symptoms of colds, fever, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Rudbeckia fulgida var. spathulata include analgesic, antiseptic, and anti-inflammatory effects, which can be attributed to its bioactive constituents, including sesquiterpenes, phenolic acids, and flavonoids. The bioactive constituents of this plant have been shown to have potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation, protecting against oxidative stress, and exhibiting antimicrobial activity.
